test_title: PYST 10: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹900 at an interest rate of 6% per month in 12 months.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹900

Rate of Interest (r) = 6% per month

Time (t) = 12 months

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times r times t}{100}

**Calculations:**

SI = dfrac{900 times 6 times 12}{100}

⇒ SI = dfrac{64800}{100}

⇒ SI = ₹648

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
